title: Nephi urges his brothers
summary: Nephi urges his brothers to return to Jerusalem and be faithful, invoking Moses and the deliverance of their fathers. He reminds them that an angel has spoken to them and says the Lord can deliver them.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi speaks to his brothers and urges them to go up again to Jerusalem and keep the Lord’s commandments.
Nephi invokes Moses, the division of the Red Sea, the Israelites’ passage on dry ground, and the drowning of Pharaoh’s armies.
Nephi says his brothers know an angel has spoken to them and that the Lord can deliver them and destroy Laban as he did the Egyptians.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi addresses his brothers as they consider returning to Jerusalem.
unspecified_visual_details: The precise place of this conversation and the brothers’ expressions are not stated.

spoken_dialogue.text: Let us go up again unto Jerusalem, and let us be faithful in keeping the commandments of the Lord;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

spoken_dialogue.text: Let us go up; the Lord is able to deliver us, even as our fathers, and to destroy Laban, even as the Egyptians.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Nephi

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Red Sea account is recalled in speech, not shown as a present event.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Moses, the Red Sea crossing, Pharaoh’s armies, or an angel as visibly present.

explicit_facts.text: At night Nephi causes his brothers to hide outside the walls, then enters the city and goes toward Laban’s house.

title: Nephi considers the law and records
summary: Nephi hears words, remembers the Lord’s words spoken in the wilderness, reasons that his seed need the law to keep the law of Moses, knows the law is engraved on the plates of brass, and understands why the Lord delivered Laban into his hands.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi hears words and remembers the Lord’s words spoken to him in the wilderness: if his seed keep the Lord’s commandments, they shall prosper in the land of promise.
Nephi thinks his seed cannot keep the Lord’s commandments according to the law of Moses unless they have the law.
Nephi knows the law is engraved upon the plates of brass.
Nephi knows the Lord delivered Laban into his hands so that he might obtain the records according to the Lord’s commandments.
